title: IDL: improving a SolidWorks workflow
summary: As a Design Engineer at IDL Worldwide, I worked with the team to reduce store-drawing turnaround from eight hours to two hours, then personally reduced it to 37 minutes.

hero.title: IDL: improving a SolidWorks workflow
hero.subtitle: Two stages of improvement, with a clear distinction between the team result and my contribution.
hero.summary: I worked on store drawings for a nationwide Apple fixture rollout at AT&T retail locations. Alongside that delivery work, I helped improve the SolidWorks drawing workflow.

overview.title: Store drawings for a national retail rollout
overview.description: At IDL Worldwide, I digitized more than 500 AT&T retail locations in SolidWorks to support Apple fixture installations. Store-drawing turnaround was initially eight hours.

solution.title: Improve the workflow, then keep refining it
solution.description: The improvement happened in two stages. With my team, I reduced drawing turnaround from eight hours to two hours. I subsequently refined my own workflow and reduced it to 37 minutes.

steps.title: Team improvement
steps.description: Worked with the team to bring the eight-hour turnaround down to two hours.

steps.title: Individual refinement
steps.description: Continued improving my own workflow after the team change, reaching 37 minutes.

impact.title: Drawing turnaround and delivery scope
impact.description: The two-hour result belongs to the team. The later 37-minute result describes my individual workflow.

conclusion.title: What this work contributes
conclusion.description: This is professional design-engineering experience in improving a complex production workflow. It informs how I approach repeated tasks, handoffs, and the effort required to move work forward.
